pack_name: Energy and Power Sector Compliance Overlay
description: Sector-specific screening controls for Nigerian electricity generation, transmission, distribution, supply, embedded generation, eligible customer, safety, technical code, metering, customer protection, and regulatory compliance documents.

metadata.scope: Nigeria-only sector overlay for Energy and Power Sector Compliance Overlay; intended to be applied with core_control_library.
metadata.source_note: Source basis reviewed against official Nigerian statutes, regulations, regulator rules, codes, directives and standards current to 2026-08-30. This deterministic screening pack requires qualified human review before legal or regulatory reliance.
metadata.external_knowledge_policy: No external knowledge is introduced during document evaluation. Regulatory source mappings live only in this versioned rule pack.

primary_sources.name: Electricity Act, 2023 and current NERC/state electricity regulatory framework
primary_sources.issuer: Federal Republic of Nigeria / NERC / applicable State Electricity Regulatory Commissions

primary_sources.name: NERC Distribution Code and Metering Code for NESI, Third Edition (March 2026)
Health & Safety Code for the Nigerian Electricity Supply Industry, Second Edition (March 2026)
NERC Eligible Customer Regulations 2024, Mini-Grid Regulations 2026 and Net Billing Regulations 2026
